learning_outcomes.text: Explain the mathematical concepts from the course (equations & functions, derivatives, vectors & matrices, optimization and statistics) in a mathematically correct manner.
Correctly solve a mathematical problem (equations & functions, derivatives, vectors & matrices, optimization and statistics) through logical steps, and correctly interpret the result.
Perform mathematical calculations (equations & functions, derivatives, vectors & matrices, optimization and statistics) carefully, both manually and using a calculator.

syllabus_topics: Fundamental algebra: exponents, roots, logarithms, equations, etc.
Functions: concept and overview of elementary functions and their properties.
Fundamentals of linear algebra including vectors, matrices, eigenvalues, etc.
Multivariate optimization, both mathematical and numerical solutions (gradient descent, ...), and backpropagation.
Basic principles of statistics and probability, including mean / median / mode, distributions, conditional probability, etc.
Application of statistics and probability commonly found in the field of AI, such as linear regression, Naive Bayes, ...
assessment_rules: The total score (out of 20) is calculated as max(exam, 0.9 * exam + 0.1 * assignments), where 'exam' is the result of the final exam (out of 20) and 'assignments' is the average result (out of 20) of the assignments given throughout the semester. These assignments are not mandatory. During the final exam, students may use the formularium provided by the lecturer and a regular scientific calculator; graphic calculators are not allowed. For the second examination opportunity, the total grade is calculated 100% based on the resit exam during the third examination period. There are no partial transfers for this course.
